scripts.adapter:build: cd adapter && mkdir -p bin && go build -o bin/relay-agent-adapter ./cmd/relay-agent-adapter && go build -o bin/relay-session-importer ./cmd/relay-session-importer
scripts.adapter:check: cd adapter && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go test ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.cloud:check: cd cloud && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/relay-wrangler.log npm run check
scripts.desktop:check: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo check --locked --all-targets
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm test:frontend && pnpm schema:check && pnpm adapter:check && pnpm cloud:check && pnpm desktop:check
